note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-5 English Wikipedia article 'Leopard 2'. The article is a secondary compilation, so every value is grade claimed and the registry marks primary_held false. It holds the German Leopard 2A6 and the Finnish 2A6, Greek 2A6 HEL and Hungarian 2A7 national variants as tracked entries. The article publishes the 2A6 mass, length, width and height, the ground clearance, the engine model and rating, the maximum road speed and the road range, and the 2A7V mass. The national entries reuse the published 2A6 family figures and say so in each state. The held tier-4 KNDS product page for the LEOPARD 2 A6 corroborates the overall length, the published power and the maximum road speed; those three values now carry the maker source. The maker table describes the A6M configuration, whose weight, width, height and range differ, so the compilation values for the operating weight, width, height, ground clearance, fording depth, wading depth, engine model and range stay at grade claimed.
